title: Lead Response Agent
description: Answers every enquiry the second it lands. Someone fills in your form or rings while you're up a roof, and the Lead Response agent replies, texts back the missed call, and books them straight into your calendar. No lead sits waiting. No callback gets forgotten.
features: Replies to every web, email, and social enquiry on the hours you set
Texts back missed calls so no caller goes cold
Answers the common questions on pricing, grants, and timelines
Qualifies the lead and books the call into your calendar
Captures the after-hours enquiries and hands them to you in the morning
Passes anything tricky straight to you

title: Operations Agent
description: Keeps the whole pipeline moving. The Operations agent tracks every job from first enquiry to handover, briefs you once a week on where things stand, and spots the jobs that have stalled before they cost you. Nothing slips.
features: Tracks every job from enquiry through to handover
Weekly brief on pipeline health and what needs you
Flags the stalled jobs before they go cold
Keeps grants, ESB Networks paperwork, and scheduling in step
Live view of where every job stands
Nudges the next step so nothing waits on you

title: Site Survey Agent
description: Gets the survey booked and the crew ready. The Site Survey agent finds a slot that suits the homeowner, pulls together the site details you need, and confirms the visit the day before so nobody's left standing on a driveway.
features: Books the survey around the homeowner's availability
Preps the site details and MPRN ahead of the visit
Confirms the appointment the day before
Sends the homeowner what to have ready
Reschedules cleanly when plans change
Hands the surveyor a tidy brief

title: Proposal Agent
description: Turns a survey into a proposal you can send. The Proposal agent drafts the quote, prices the job off your own numbers, and lays it out clean, ready for your sign-off. You check it and send. No more evenings lost to writing quotes.
features: Drafts the proposal from the survey and the bill
Prices the job on your own rates
Lays out panels, savings, and grant clearly
Ready for your sign-off before it goes out
Keeps every quote consistent and on-brand
Sends it on once you approve

title: Grants Agent
description: Fills the SEAI paperwork and the ESB Networks NC6 and NC7 forms for you, then tracks every application and deadline so none of them slip. You approve and submit; the agent does the filling and the chasing.
features: Fills the SEAI grant paperwork for each job
Fills the ESB Networks NC6 and NC7 forms
Tracks every application and its deadline
Flags what's due before it lapses
Keeps the grant rates and criteria current
You approve and submit; nothing goes without your say-so

title: Follow-Up Agent
description: Chases the leads you don't have time to. The Follow-Up agent keeps after the quiet ones, re-warms the cold ones, and follows up on every proposal until you get a yes or a no. It never forgets, and it never gets awkward about asking.
features: Follows up on every proposal until there's an answer
Re-warms the leads that went quiet
Keeps the timing right, not pushy
Brings the warm ones back to you
Logs every touch so you can see the trail
Frees you from remembering who to ring

title: Install Coordinator Agent
description: Lines up the install so the day runs itself. The Install Coordinator agent schedules the job, gets the ESB Networks grid connection paperwork in order, and confirms the crew and the homeowner so everyone shows up ready.
features: Schedules the install around the crew and the homeowner
Lines up the ESB Networks grid connection paperwork
Confirms the crew and the materials for the day
Keeps the homeowner in the loop on timing
Flags clashes before they hit the calendar
Hands the crew a clear plan for the day

title: Aftercare Agent
description: Looks after the customer once the panels are on. The Aftercare agent handles the handover, checks in after the job, and asks for the review while the homeowner's still delighted. Happy customers, more referrals, no chasing from you.
features: Walks the homeowner through the handover
Checks in after the install is done
Asks for the review at the right moment
Surfaces any snag straight to you
Turns happy customers into referrals
Keeps the relationship warm after sign-off
